text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a new gadget's coming out~ Guess I'll 
definitely be buying that one~.

Huh? A present for the folks back in 
Funabashi?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! And see, we're looking for 
a gift for people around our parents' age!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I tried looking into it using feng shui, 
but nothing clicked. Please! Won't you 
lend us a hand?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Um, to begin with... is it really true 
that Espo-san is knowledgeable about the 
culture of that generation?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Because just the other day when we 
had lunch together—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"This song... Hmph, why're they playing 
this kind of track nowadays—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? ...I don't know this song. Is it 
famous?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"From thirty years ago, yeah. Well, guess 
it'd be weirder for folks today to know 
it."

Ahhh~. If we're talking about that, I 
noticed something too~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I'm kinda in the mood for classic films 
today~. ...Wait, isn't that—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Espon! Huh, you're watching this? It's a 
suuuuper old title, and a sequel at that."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Shut it! What's wrong with me watchin' 
it?! Hey, it's startin'! Hurry up and get 
in!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. ...My analysis says it's gotta be 
parental influence. And specifically... 
her mom's, perhaps~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Hah?! It's not like that at all, 
dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Please lend me your aid. ...I want to 
repay my debt of gratitude to the people 
of Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Man from Funabashi
text_block_list.text:
"This is Funabashi miso. I'll send over 
some clams later, so cook 'em up as 
'fukashi' stew and eat well."

text_block_list.name: Man from Funabashi
text_block_list.text:
"This'll help you remember, right? 
Remember Funabashi—and that you're never 
alone."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"—! ...Yes! Thank you so much! I will 
gladly enjoy it."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That gift back then made me so happy. It 
was so warm and comforting.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: That is why I want to return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
However... I don't know. I don't know what 
kind of gift would bring them joy—

text_block_list.name: Young Espo
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... What should I do, what should I 
do?! What can I give Mom that'll make her 
happy...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Arrrggghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Fine, fine! I'll help you out, dammit! Not 
like you'd listen even if I said no 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Really?! Ah... thank you so much!

While walking down the hallway, I heard 
some familiar voices.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's this Saturday, got it?! Don't you 
dare forget!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I look forward to working with you 
this weekend.
